title: Where the GMP share comes from, and a faster chain
set_out: Find whether the IAM-Deconvolver's GMP share in healthy blood is cells or the measurement, and make each test take minutes, not hours.
open_at_turnover: Group-A's rehearsal against the atlas alone; sequencing step 1, each library's own measured end profile in its expected value, synthetic first; the territories' re-commissioning.
closing: Met-A and the C-Score commissioned against the atlas alone on the cells it reads, and the next steps set: the rest of the array instruments, then each sequencing library calibrated on its own known sites.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Both probe designs measured against their own error
entries.what: The atlas's 57 sorted neutrophil donors (spent), each read by the one command; the departure from IAM-Atlas v2.1's neutrophil column (the healthy reference) projected on GMP's direction, per probe design, with a bootstrap error.
entries.outcome: Each probe design departs by laboratory in GMP's direction, far above its own error, and the two designs disagree laboratory by laboratory. Cells would move both alike, so the GMP share is a per-design laboratory distortion of the measurement.

entries.title: The 34 healthy plasmas with the megakaryocyte column
entries.what: The 34 healthy GSE186007 plasmas read again by the one command with the built megakaryocyte column in the Deconvolver's reference, scored remotely.
entries.outcome: As the test said it would if the lead is right: megakaryocytes at 1 % or more in 25 of 34 plasmas (none before); erythrocyte progenitors from 0.0752 to 0.0354 and the macrophage columns from 0.1648 to 0.1436. Part of the plasmas' shares explained, not all.

entries.title: COMMISSION-METAA-SORTED-01: Met-A commissioned against the atlas alone
entries.what: 79 healthy sorted neutrophils and monocytes from five laboratories the atlas never held, sealed before any was read, each read by the one command against IAM-Atlas v2.1 alone.
entries.outcome: All three bars met: 73 of 74 scored arrays found as the sorted kind, 66 of 66 with a state Normal. Met-A is commissioned on sorted neutrophils (450K) and sorted monocytes (EPIC v1).

entries.title: COMMISSION-MONO450-01: Met-A and the C-Score on sorted monocytes (450K)
entries.what: 19 healthy sorted monocytes on 450K from two laboratories the atlas never held, sealed before any was read, read by the one command against IAM-Atlas v2.1 alone.
entries.outcome: All three bars met: 19 of 19 found as monocytes, Met-A Normal in 13 of 14 with a state, the C-Score within its atlas-measured limit in 18 of 19. Met-A extends to monocytes on 450K; the C-Score is commissioned against the atlas alone on that scope.

entries.title: The one command timed; the Deconvolver's marker sites cached
entries.what: One array took 364 s; 77.862 s of it was recomputing marker sites that depend only on the reference. They are now kept per machine under a key made from the reference's own numbers.
entries.outcome: Identity check running: the same array read twice must give identical bundles.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: The GMP share is not cells and not random noise
entries.what: Random noise added past the noisiest laboratory made no GMP; the departure sits on both probe designs, differently in each laboratory.
entries.outcome: The correction has to come from each array's own response per design, measured on its own calibrators across the whole range.

entries.title: Sequencing laboratories differ at the molecules' ends
entries.what: 30 spent aligned libraries, opposite calls by position on the molecule, site-matched.
entries.outcome: Interior error rates agree across laboratories; the end calls read 0.86 to 12.4 times the inner rate, library by library. Each library's own measured end profile is the next step, rather than cutting data.

entries.title: The lymphocyte widths rest on two laboratories
entries.what: The atlas's pure lymphocyte donors by laboratory, and sorted lymphocytes from two laboratories the atlas never held.
entries.outcome: Both outside laboratories read lymphocytes 3 to 5 percent below 1 while the atlas's own two read 1, so the width needs more laboratories; lymphocyte readings are shown as observations until then.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes, and what caught each

entries.title: "Design II only" stated before design I's error was measured
entries.what: The first reading called the departure design II only; design I's projection had not yet been judged against its own error.
entries.outcome: Corrected in the record once measured: design I also departs by laboratory.
